unit.why: A run of homiletic interpretations of verses and liturgy (Ecclesiastes, Hoshanot, Kings, Psalms, Berakhot, Torah portions) attributed to Hasidic masters, with no narrated events; the only situational framing (a homily said before the Ropshitser after a tsaddik's death) is just the occasion for a saying.
unit.boundary_note: teaching on parashat Korah breaks off mid-sentence and continues into next division; the next division appears to begin a separate story
